description:
This diagram illustrates the processing workflow for generating the High Resolution Water Layer (HRWL) products. The workflow begins with multiple "WIC S2 scene based probability" inputs. These probabilities are fed into a "Resample to 10 m" step. In parallel, a "WCD module" generates "Water occurrence layers (WOL)".

Both the output from the "Resample to 10 m" step and the "Water occurrence layers (WOL)" are processed by the central "HRWL module". The "HRWL module" produces a "Rolling Archive (WLRA)" and splits the processing into two subsequent HRWL submodules.

One branch leads to the "HRWL submodule Confidence layer", which directly generates the "HR Water Confidence Layer (WCL)". The second branch leads to the "HRWL submodule WPI & WL", which produces two distinct products: the "HR Water Presence Index (WPI)" and the "Water Layer (WL)".
